title: LLVM utilities 23.1.3 macOS ARM64
redistribution: Unmodified llvm-readobj, llvm-nm, llvm-objdump and llvm-pdbutil from the official LLVM 23.1.3 macOS ARM64 distribution, selected without filesystem extraction and repacked into gzip tar. Requires macOS 14 or newer. Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception and included notices apply; the exact corresponding full LLVM source is included. Only system libSystem/libz/libc++ are dynamically required by these four executables.
